# mimecast_dmarc_users (Data Source)

Read all DMARC Analyzer users, group access, and feature permissions with cursor pagination.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mimecast_dmarc_users" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable DMARC Analyzer user inventory ID.
- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `aggregate_reports` (Boolean) Whether the user can access aggregate reports.
- `alerts_and_notifications` (Boolean) Whether the user can access alerts and notifications.
- `allowed_groups` (Attributes List) Domain groups the user may access. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--allowed_groups))
- `dns_checker` (Boolean) Whether the user can access the DNS checker.
- `dns_delegation` (Boolean) Whether the user can access DNS delegation.
- `dns_generator` (Boolean) Whether the user can access the DNS generator.
- `domain_management` (Boolean) Whether the user can access domain management.
- `encryption_pgp_key` (Boolean) Whether the user can access encryption PGP keys.
- `forensic_reports` (Boolean) Whether the user can access forensic reports.
- `id` (String) DMARC Analyzer user ID.
- `reporting` (Boolean) Whether the user can access reporting.
- `task_manager` (Boolean) Whether the user can access task management.
- `timeline` (Boolean) Whether the user can access the timeline.
- `tls_reports` (Boolean) Whether the user can access SMTP TLS reports.
- `user_email` (String, Sensitive) User email address.
- `user_management` (Boolean) Whether the user can access user management.
- `user_name` (String, Sensitive) User name.
- `user_permission` (String) User permission level.
- `vendor_management` (Boolean) Whether the user can access vendor management.

<a id="nestedatt--items--allowed_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.allowed_groups`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Domain-group ID.
- `name` (String) Domain-group name.
- `type` (String) Domain-group type.
